name: notch
description: Notch — child growth tracking. Monorepo root.

overrides: Expo SDK 57 is built against exactly these versions (see expo/bundledNativeModules.json).
Most React Native consumers declare a peer range of '*', so npm is free to hoist a newer
React Native to the root while apps/mobile keeps its pinned copy nested. Two copies in one
tree is broken on its own, and it also breaks the Expo CLI specifically: the CLI resolves
react-native through plain Node require from the root, and RN 0.87 dropped the
'./rn-get-polyfills' subpath the CLI still imports, so bundling fails outright.
Pinning here keeps a single copy of each and keeps that copy the one Expo supports.

dependencies: Declared at the root, not only in apps/mobile, because @expo/cli is installed at the root
and reaches react-native through plain Node require from its own directory - which walks up
to the root, never sideways into a workspace. npm otherwise nests react-native under
apps/mobile (the only workspace declaring it) and the CLI cannot see it at all.
Versions must stay identical to apps/mobile's so the two dedupe to one copy.
